name: Mohammed Bakri
tagline: Building scalable software and practical AI-powered solutions.
bio: I'm Mohammed — a computer science student and software developer based in Sana'a, Yemen. I build web applications, REST APIs, database-driven systems and mobile apps, and I'm happiest working on the backend.

Most of my time goes into Tabib, a clinic management system I founded and build end-to-end. Alongside that I work across ASP.NET Core, React and TypeScript, Flutter, and practical AI applications with Python, NumPy and Scikit-learn.
I'm interested in software architecture, scalable systems and machine learning — especially the places where those three meet.
